rule: body text and controls meet applicable WCAG contrast expectations
why: low contrast blocks reading and action
check: check normal disabled hover focus and visited states

rule: keyboard-focusable elements have a visible focus indicator
check: tab through critical flow and verify focus never disappears

rule: primary mobile controls have about 44x44pt or dp-equivalent hit area
check: inspect hit area not only icon size

rule: icon-only controls expose an accessible name
why: screen readers cannot infer decorative glyph intent
check: inspect accessibility tree and localized label

rule: use native semantic roles before custom div or canvas behavior
why: native semantics improve assistive technology support
check: inspect rendered role name and state

why: motion can cause discomfort and disorientation
check: enable reduced motion and repeat critical flow

rule: validation errors explain what happened and how to recover
check: submit invalid form with keyboard and screen reader

rule: mobile layout survives larger text settings
why: fixed-height labels clip and hide information

rule: do not encode state only by red or green
check: check labels icons or patterns accompany color

rule: focused input and submit action remain visible above software keyboard
check: open keyboard on narrow viewport and submit

rule: content reflows at zoom or narrow width without loss
why: overflow forces users to guess or scroll sideways
check: check 200 percent zoom and narrow viewport

rule: dynamic updates are announced or otherwise discoverable
why: async success and errors can be missed
check: trigger update and inspect live region or semantics

rule: drag or hover behavior has keyboard and touch alternative
check: complete action without hover or drag

rule: labels instructions autocomplete and errors are associated with controls
check: inspect label relationship and field order
